dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (Japan Medical Association open-source receipt system); compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux
evidence: EXIT PROGRAM with USING linkage area

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (shinryo-hoshu) software — screen Z99 for point-number master input code setting
purpose.summary: This program implements the Z99 screen of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system, handling the input-code setting for a point-number (tensuu) master. It processes screen navigation events (LINK, PUTG/CLICKED, ACTIVATE), validates entered codes, and manages SPA (screen parameter area) data for the point-number master entry screen.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (26 copybooks) for screen areas and common parameters
MCP (Message Control Program) interface pattern typical of ORCA
EVALUATE on MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT for event-driven screen handling
Japanese text in comments (EUC-JP encoding rendered as latin-1 mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary MCP DB interface
OCCURS tables for screen row data (up to 23 entries)
GO TO used for early exit from validation sections
verdict.notes: Comment text is Japanese encoded in EUC-JP but decoded as latin-1, producing mojibake. Source is truncated at 16000 chars (~36% of file). The program is clearly part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system, a production GnuCOBOL application widely deployed in Japanese medical clinics.
